title: Zymo Quick-DNA/RNA Viral Kit with PCR Prep
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather hardware and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: Opentrons OT‑2 robot, OT‑2 Run App (version 3.19.0 or later), Opentrons Magnetic Module GEN2, Opentrons P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette, Opentrons P20 (or P10) Single‑Channel Pipette, 200 µL filter tips (recommended) or 300 µL tips, a deep‑well plate pre‑loaded with 400 µL sample per well, a 96‑well PCR plate for elution, and any other labware shown in the deck map. This kit can be used for Station B (RNA extraction) of the COVID Workstation.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Obtain the Zymo Quick‑DNA/RNA Viral Kit with PCR Prep protocol file from the Opentrons protocol library.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT‑2 App
steps.instruction: Open the OT‑2 Run App and upload the downloaded protocol into the application.

steps.title: Configure deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up the robot deck exactly as shown in the deck map: place the magnetic module GEN2, load the deep‑well plate containing 400 µL of each sample, position the 96‑well PCR plate for the 60 µL elution, and add the appropriate tip racks (200 µL filter tips recommended or 300 µL tips).

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, calibrate all labware, tip racks, the P300 multi‑channel pipette, and the P20 (or P10) single‑channel pipette according to the app’s calibration procedure.

steps.title: Run automated purification
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App. The robot will execute the Zymo Quick‑DNA/RNA Viral MagBead workflow, distributing PCR mastermix before elution, processing up to 48 samples (any multiple of 8), starting with 400 µL sample and finishing with 60 µL elution dispensed into the 96‑well PCR plate, ready for RT/qPCR, Next‑Gen Sequencing, hybridization, etc.
